scope: A source-independent, ID-preserving representation for behavior-bearing content. This contract does not assert that every listed external operation already has reconstructed runtime semantics.

behavior_record.behavior_id: stable canonical ID; preserves source path plus named record when no game ID is available
behavior_record.source_refs: one or more immutable raw source references with version relation and hash
behavior_record.raw_unknown: lossless JSON fallback for unclassified fields

operation.source_type: verbatim external/local type discriminator when available
operation.kind: canonical operation kind from the mapping below, otherwise OPAQUE
operation.target: canonical target expression plus lossless source payload
operation.children: ordered nested operation IDs for conditional/loop/container operations
operation.source_payload: unaltered operation object or content-addressed reference

headless_rule: Presentation-only operations are retained in provenance/order but may be omitted only after the compiler establishes they do not gate an effect, action completion, legal action, target, resource, or scheduler transition. They must never be silently deleted from raw evidence.
compiler_contract: Read canonical behavior records only; never read external raw JSON at runtime.
Compile ordered operations recursively and preserve unknown types as opaque compile failures or explicit disabled operations according to Scenario unsupported_policy.
Bind every operation to an explicit target context, state read/write set, event/phase boundary and semantic packet dependency before marking it COMPILED.
Use the Dynamic MVP packet set only for its documented ordinary scopes; do not extend its closure claim to arbitrary source operation types.
Expose behavior/operation IDs in trace output so a mismatch is attributable to source content, IR mapping or kernel packet.

acceptance.schema_acceptance: Natasha, Black Swan, one Monster ability and one Stage Buff raw file all normalize into behavior records with named entrypoints and ordered operations without losing unclassified payload.
acceptance.vertical_slice_acceptance: One free Scenario Package can reference compiled Avatar, Monster and Buff behavior IDs while rejecting any operation whose required semantic packet is missing.
acceptance.full_coverage_gate: No content family is called complete until every behavior denominator is either GOLDEN_TESTED or explicitly outside the published supported corpus.

dsh_implementation_contract: Implement this IR as typed immutable records plus an opaque JSON fallback; make compiler coverage and failure reports first-class. Do not turn unrecognized source types into no-ops.
